title: Grievance Redressal Committee | KPGU
content: dge Shri Ketan Kumar Dasondi Family Court, Surat. SUBMISSION PROCESS Procedure for Submitting Step-by-step approach Any stakeholder with a genuine grievance should initially approach the Department Student Grievance Redressal Committee (DSGRC) or the Institutional Student Grievance Redressal Committee (ISGRC). In the event that grievances still remain unresolved, students are encouraged to approach the University Grievance Redressal Committee (USGRC) to formally submit their grievances.
